purpose: Compare isolated Rust and original Swift worker outputs using the same pinned models; small regression sample, not an accuracy or latency benchmark.

attribution.creator: Google Research and FLEURS contributors
attribution.changes: Audio converted to mono 16 kHz f32; mixed case concatenates public clips with silence. References unchanged; generated model outputs are included separately.
